title: The record, and what it implies for the inventory

outcome.description: What happened, read from the decision and its comment. `deferred` when the decider neither adopted nor declined but asked for something first.

inventoryDelta.title: The one change this decision makes to current-tools.md
inventoryDelta.description: A proposal for a human to apply. Nothing here is written to the registry by this persona.

action.description: `none` for everything that was not adopted, and for an adoption that changes no line.

capability.title: The capability row it belongs on

supersedes.title: Entries this replaces
supersedes.description: Only tools the decider actually agreed to retire. An overlap that nobody decided to remove is not superseded.

note.title: The Notes cell for the inventory row

conditions.title: Conditions the decider attached
conditions.description: Taken from the decision comment, one per entry, each a thing someone must do. Empty when none were attached.

overlapsAccepted.title: Overlaps adopted anyway
overlapsAccepted.description: Overlaps the review raised that the decision went ahead over. The next proposal in this category needs to see these.

revisitBy.title: When the decider said to look again
revisitBy.description: Only when a date was actually given.

summary.description: Two sentences at most: what was decided and what has to happen now.
